P1.project_objective: Build-cost amortisation before any new search policy
P1.implementation_ref: `handoffs/active/autokernel-loop.md:6667` — median iteration 2,675 s = build 2,025 (75.7%) / measured 105 (3.9%); `:6668` — 44 of 51 anchor rebuilds byte-identical; `:6666` — compiling 29.0 h against GPU held 1.403 h, `-j 1` in 77/77 logs.
P1.gap: Build is 2,025 s of a median 2,675 s iteration, the content-addressed store is never consulted, and the build is serial on a 192-thread host.
P1.operational_change: Make the loop consult the content-addressed kernel store before compiling and stop serialising a 192-thread build, with build seconds recorded per attempt.
P1.benefit_direction: Down: per-attempt build wall and redundant compilations. Up: measured iterations per hour at equal GPU time.
P1.execution_conditions: CPU quarters only; no GPU. One build claim per row. A/B on identical source.
P1.closure_basis: Abandon the packet if build seconds stay within 20% of baseline or a byte-identical policy cannot be proven. If build falls below 20% of iteration wall, this packet is done and no wider reproduction is warranted.

P2.project_objective: Warm measurement worker for the churn pipeline
P2.implementation_ref: `docs/guides/agent-workflows/compute-fillers.md:46` (one grant is one run), `docs/guides/agent-workflows/backlog-churn-flow.md:53` (startup alone never counts), `docs/guides/agent-workflows/agent-loop-design.md:522` (model load 282 -> 163-170 s, host ~85% idle).
P2.gap: Each measurement row pays a dry-run launch and a model load of its own; no grant window is shared across units.
P2.operational_change: Hold one grant across N measurement units and delete the per-row dry-run launch and model load, measuring `published_at -> first_result_unit`.
P2.benefit_direction: Down: wall and launches per completed measurement; up: measurements per grant-hour. No change to what is measured.
P2.execution_conditions: Phase A zero-GPU replay over 20 closed rows; phase B one live warm window on an idle grant. Single writer; cache/state bound by the recipe.
P2.closure_basis: Stop on a <10% median saving, or on the first unit whose measurement context differs from its cold twin. If warm state is shown to change a verdict, revert to cold measurement and keep only the instrumentation.

P3.project_objective: Keep-gate tail discipline and tier-fidelity evidence
P3.implementation_ref: `handoffs/active/kernel-champion-and-promotion.md` keep-gate track (2.00% floor, matched pairs); `handoffs/active/autokernel-loop.md:5730` item 6 (only 8 judgeable screen/confirmed pairs, ratios 0.587 to -26.95).
P3.gap: Tail inflation is absent from the keep gate and only 8 strictly paired screen/confirmed rows exist, so tier fidelity is unmeasured.
P3.operational_change: Make tail inflation a first-class gate input and establish, from existing receipts, whether the fast tier ranks like the full tier before paying for a new GPU experiment.
P3.benefit_direction: Down: false keeps from tail-heavy comparisons and unnecessary tier experiments. Up: keeps that survive re-measurement.
P3.execution_conditions: Replay is zero GPU and runs first; the GPU experiment is gated on the replay being inconclusive.
P3.closure_basis: Refuse to widen the floor without a measured P on the same row; stop the replay when the CI resolves the 0.7 question. A 24-pair MI210 layer-subset experiment only if the replay CI straddles 0.7.

P4.project_objective: GDN prefill oracle and the LinQuant transfer decision
P4.implementation_ref: `handoffs/active/model-architecture-readiness.md:62` (75% of the stack is standard GDN), `:182` (state size); frozen tree `src/models/delta-net-base.cpp` chunked graph and `ggml/src/ggml-cuda/gated_delta_net.cu:191` fused-kernel TODO.
P4.gap: There is no fp64 oracle for the chunked GDN graph and the recurrence core's share of wall time has never been measured.
P4.operational_change: Install a CPU fp64 oracle for the chunked graph and measure the recurrence core's share of wall time, so the LinQuant line is decided by a number rather than by its abstract.
P4.benefit_direction: Down: risk of a silent divergence in the WY prep/state pass. Decision: close or keep the LinQuant implementation line.
P4.execution_conditions: Oracle: CPU only, no weights. Profile: one MI210 grant, one CPU quarter, Q8_0, DS41/Q38FN shape.
P4.closure_basis: Close the LinQuant implementation line if the core is under 5% of prefill or decode wall; keep the oracle regardless. A full LinQuant reproduction only after an INT8 recurrence core exists and the core share is material.

P5.project_objective: Quantization records, head bytes and the rotation probe
P5.implementation_ref: `handoffs/active/quantization-and-low-bit.md` current low-bit line (DS41/Q38FN); llama.cpp lm-head read path; intake-2646 dive's byte arithmetic.
P5.gap: Head and embedding bytes have never been priced and activation rotation has never been tested at our real block budget.
P5.operational_change: Price the one byte-level lever this intake found (4-bit head/embeddings on a bandwidth-bound decode) and settle the rotation question offline at our real block budget.
P5.benefit_direction: Down: bytes read per generated token. Knowledge: whether activation rotation has any positive sign at per-32-block granularity.
P5.execution_conditions: Offline audit and numpy probe only; no GPU, no converter change until the audit justifies one conversion arm.
P5.closure_basis: Stop the conversion arm if any task regresses beyond its recorded sigma; record the null if no rotation arm beats control. A converter-level rotation arm only if the offline probe shows a win larger than the window-error noise.

K1.gap: Corrections, hazards and protocol rules with no active consumer
K1.operational_change: Record the correction or hazard where the next reader will meet it
K1.benefit_direction: Prevents a corrected premise from being re-derived
K1.execution_conditions: Stage-2 record edits already applied; no GPU or CPU work
K1.closure_basis: Closed by the recorded correction in each affected entry.

M1.gap: Conditions that are real but not yet true
M1.operational_change: Keep each condition as owned prose with no active checkbox
M1.benefit_direction: Materializes work only when its stated condition fires
M1.execution_conditions: Armed only on the stated condition
M1.closure_basis: Closed as durable prose until its condition fires.
